Overcoming the Challenges of Disability

战胜残障带来的困难 · 246 词 · 3 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1Yang’s ambition was to obtain an architect’s licence or master the game of bowling. But when he was conducting experiments with a microscope in the basement, a tank on the bench exploded, sending him flying through the exit. He was gasping for breath. He later learned that he had lost his eyesight and 70% of his hearing. In other words, he was disabled.

2Feeling clumsy, he was annoyed at first though nobody made fun of him. He stopped going out and just sat at home, talking quietly to his parrot or tortoise. His sister resigned from her job to help him in many ways. Her assistance and encouragement helped him adjust to his disability and become outgoing again. At a college that was accessible to him, he studied politics and literature. He always sat in the front row near the entrance and never missed a class and, with the help of his handy laptop, he kept up with his studies through dictation. His thesis, Abolishing Slavery, met with the approval of all his professors. After class, he and his companions often played the drums, which was noisy but suitable for his hearing. After graduation, he made good money designing software for a company. All in all, in his community, he gained a sense of dignity and received congratulations.

3He always wished all the best to other people with disabilities and encouraged them, “Don’t give up. You have what you need to achieve something of your own.”

高考英语3500词 · 31中文译文

战胜残障带来的困难

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1杨原本想取得建筑师执照，或者成为保龄球高手。但他在地下室用显微镜做实验时，工作台上的容器突然爆炸，把他从出口炸了出去。他喘不过气来，后来得知自己的视力完全丧失，听力也损失了七成。换句话说，他成了一名残障人士。

2起初，尽管没人取笑他，行动笨拙还是让他心烦。他不再出门，只在家里坐着，低声和鹦鹉或乌龟说话。他姐姐辞了职，从许多方面帮助他。有了姐姐的照顾和鼓励，他逐渐适应了身体的变化，也重新开朗起来。他在一所方便他就读的大学学习政治和文学，总坐在入口附近的第一排，一节课都没缺。借助好用的笔记本电脑，他靠听写把学习跟了上来。他的论文《废除奴隶制》得到了所有教授的认可。下课后，他常和同伴一起打鼓。鼓声虽然吵，却适合他的听力。毕业后，他为一家公司设计软件，赚了不少钱。总的来说，他在社区里感受到了自己的尊严，也收获了大家的祝贺。

3他总是祝愿其他残障人士一切顺利，并鼓励他们说：“别灰心！凭你拥有的东西，你也能做出自己的成绩。”
